tasks.command: cd backend && scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new user/create_trip_request.php root@76.13.114.194:/var/www/viax/backend/user/create_trip_request.php && ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new root@76.13.114.194 "cd /var/www/viax/backend && php scripts/check_pending_migrations.php | tee /tmp/viax_check_pending_migrations.out && if grep -q PENDING_MIGRATIONS_FOUND /tmp/viax_check_pending_migrations.out; then php scripts/run_migrations.php; fi && export DEPLOY_CHANGED_FILES='user/create_trip_request.php' && chmod +x deploy.sh && ./deploy.sh && redis-cli ping && supervisorctl status && echo SMOKE1_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/viax_smoke1.txt -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1/user/create_trip_request.php -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}') && cat /tmp/viax_smoke1.txt && echo SMOKE2_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/viax_smoke2.txt -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1/conductor/update_trip_status.php -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}') && cat /tmp/viax_smoke2.txt && echo SMOKE3_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/viax_smoke3.txt -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1/user/trip_preview.php -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}') && cat /tmp/viax_smoke3.txt && echo HEALTH_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/viax_health.txt -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1/health.php) && cat /tmp/viax_health.txt"
